design_fields.q1_rationale: Matching full PDF Methods/Appendix B: estimates averaged over all 10 plausible values and variances combined with PISA formulas.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching full PDF Methods/Appendix B explicitly uses final student weight and 80 Fay replicate weights; original not_met code contradicted the source.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Matching full PDF Methods reports hierarchical linear models with random school intercepts.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Matching full PDF Methods: random forest trained on PISA 2015 Germany; evaluated first on a 20% holdout from 2015 and then on PISA 2018 Germany, an external cycle.
